title: package
description: Adds a TypeScript ESM package, with a project.json declaring the targets the plugin infers

directory.x-prompt: Which directory should the package go in?
directory.description: Where the package goes, relative to the workspace root

name.description: Name of the package. Defaults to the directory's last segment

description.description: Description, for package.json and the README

published.description: Published to npm, rather than private

floor.description: The oldest Node.js a published package supports, as `<major>.<minor>.<patch>`. 22.12.0 by default: the oldest that can `require()` ES modules, and that its test runner starts on

repository.description: URL of the workspace's GitHub repository, for a published package's repository, homepage and bugs

license.description: license of package.json. A published package also gets a copy of the workspace's LICENSE

devDependencies.description: More packages to add to devDependencies

config.description: File of the plugin options, relative to the workspace root, for a workspace running the targets executor. Defaults to the options in nx.json
